banter: Welcome. If you came to return something, please tell me it's smaller than a sarcophagus.
The gift shop is straight ahead. The exit is also straight ahead. We prefer not to advertise the difference.
Please don't lean on the display cases. The last person who did is now part of the exhibition.
repeatLines: Excellent. I'll tell the director we finally have a returning visitor.
falseLeadLines: I haven't seen anyone matching that description.
The skeleton in Gallery Three is here on a permanent basis.

destinationClues.london: They said their next stop was the British Museum. They wanted to see the stone with three kinds of writing and asked which one was the audio-guide password.
destinationClues.paris: They said their next stop had a glass pyramid in a palace courtyard. They asked if the pharaohs had a separate queue.
destinationClues.berlin: They said their next stop was an island full of museums on the River Spree. They packed a swimsuit. I didn't have the heart to say anything.
destinationClues.warsaw: They said their next stop was POLIN, the museum of the history of Polish Jews. They'd marked the building with the enormous curved hall.
destinationClues.new_york_city: They said their next stop was the Met on Fifth Avenue. Apparently, an entire Egyptian temple counts as hand luggage if you're a museum.
destinationClues.toronto: They said their next stop was the Royal Ontario Museum. They described the entrance as a giant crystal that had missed the pavement.
destinationClues.new_delhi: They said their next stop was Qutb Minar, a tall sandstone tower. They asked if the stairs were included in the ticket. Very optimistic.
destinationClues.nairobi: They said their next stop had early human fossils and a snake park next door. They asked which one had the shorter queue.
destinationClues.islamabad: They said their next stop was Lok Virsa, to see traditional dress and crafts. They brought a tape measure. I didn't ask.
destinationClues.kotte: They said their next stop was the parliament building on an island in Diyawanna Lake. They called the lake a very elaborate moat.
destinationClues.tokyo: They said their next stop was the national museum in Ueno Park. They wanted to see samurai armour and asked if there was a fitting room.
destinationClues.singapore: They said their next stop was the lotus-shaped museum by Marina Bay. They asked if the flower closed at night. I said the ticket office did.
